utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a quick look after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help, thanks. After lunch works for me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll stop by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know when the trucks are coming and where we should bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact time and the drop-off spot before we start?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can if you tell me the exact time and the drop-off spot first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed a note there - what changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I think the note changed after I saw it. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I can check what the updated plan is.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No worries, just check the updated plan when you can and let me know what changed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik. I’ll let the others know the repair drive is covered.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll let the others know too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what’s left to do on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly the trim work and a couple loose fixtures. I’ve got a drill and a ladder if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the ladder and finish the trim, then check those fixtures with you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive, with the day and time settled first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, let’s lock that in first: how does Saturday at 10 a.m. sound for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 10 a.m. works for me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How far along is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s coming along, but there’s still a bit left to do. We’ve got the main repairs underway and should know more once the next round is finished.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam. When do you expect the next round to be finished?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that repair drive, Opal. Let me know what still needs hands or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Tell me what you need moved or fixed, and I’ll point you to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect. I’ll bring the tools list and ask the crew to point me to the heaviest stuff first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you. We still need someone to handle pickups and another person to sort the donations, and I can give you the schedule right after.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can take the pickups, and I’ll help sort the donations too. Send me the schedule when you can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few extra tarps and gloves if the drive needs them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great, thanks. We can definitely use both.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll bring them by this afternoon, and I can check if I’ve got any duct tape too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are pitching in all over the block, so it should come together fast.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, I heard they’re aiming to get the biggest fixes wrapped up this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly the usual school stuff needs attention: a loose cabinet, a dripping faucet, and one wobbly door that keeps sticking.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. I can help with those three things.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. Just point me at what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks. I’ll show you the busted shelf first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely, show me the shelf and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can keep folks posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks. I’ll let people know and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll keep folks posted too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I saw something about that, but I may have missed the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think I missed the latest update too, but I can check if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, if you can check, that’d help. I’m probably missing something important.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help however I can. What part of the repair drive needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: The roof over the back porch is the sore spot. If you’ve got a ladder, I can handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got a ladder. I’ll bring it over and take a look at the porch roof with you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal. I’m organizing the repair drive list now, and I’ll make sure we cover the biggest needs first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep the list tight and make sure the urgent repairs are marked first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, then I’ll sort the rest by urgency and get the list ready for volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know the schedule first. Who's handling pickup and when does the repair start?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the pickup details before I can commit. Can you tell me who’s taking it and what time the repair starts?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is actually happening, right? I just want to confirm before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s happening. I’m just checking one detail first before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just let me know when that last detail is settled.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine by me. Tell me what time you want to start, and I’ll keep to it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can start at 6 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 6 works for me. I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m a little behind on the details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up, but I heard it’s pretty active and people are bringing in stuff to fix. Do you know what kinds of repairs they’re taking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to bring my tools, but I seem to have left them by the door again.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I should be able to patch it up once I grab them. Give me a minute and I’ll be right over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that, but I need the repair details first. What’s broken and when do you need it done?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The sink is leaking under the kitchen counter. I need it fixed by tomorrow evening.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that. I’ll need to know whether it’s a small leak or something spraying, but I’ll make sure it’s taken care of by tomorrow evening.
